ui_bugs.issue: The menu backdrop <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40"> is rendered at the same stacking level as the header (also z-40) and later in the DOM, so it covers the hamburger button itself. Playwright normal-clicks on [data-testid=hamburger-btn] time out with 'intercepts pointer events' while the menu is open, i.e. the X (close) icon is not actually clickable. Users still see the menu close because the backdrop's own onClick fires setMenuOpen(false), so the visible behaviour is correct, but the close button is dead and any automation/keyboard path to it is blocked. Fix: give the backdrop z-30 (below header) or raise the hamburger button/header to z-50.

18 products share only 6 unique Unsplash URLs (0 broken now). All 5 TMT bar cards render the same generic warehouse-shelving photo and the cement cards render a power-drill photo - images are not representative of the products. Repeat of an iteration-2 finding, still unfixed.
The raw native <input type=file> ('Choose Files TEST_a.png') is rendered visibly and unstyled above the styled 'Camera / Files' button, duplicating the same action with inconsistent styling.

issues: Hero headline is not language-aware: HomeScreen renders {heroTxt || t.b} but heroTxt always resolves to the default EN headline, so t.b is dead code and HI/TE never translate the hero. This was reported in iteration 2; note it now CONFLICTS with this iteration's requirement that the hero text be exactly 'Build Stronger. Order Smarter.' - decide which behaviour is intended and remove the dead fallback.

predict-chart bars still collapse to near-flat because height is scaled by (val-min)/(max-min) over a narrow price range; value labels and rotated month labels overlap the bars. (Carried over from iteration 2, not re-fixed.)

action_items: Lower the hamburger backdrop to z-30 (or raise header/hamburger-btn to z-50) so the X close button is genuinely clickable and not covered by the overlay.
Replace the 6 repeated/non-representative Unsplash product images with real TMT / cement / sand / brick / tool photos.
Hide the raw native file input on the Gallery screen (className='hidden') and keep only the styled Camera/Files control.
Resolve the hero i18n contradiction: either make the hero use T[lang].b or delete the unreachable '|| t.b' fallback.
Fix predict-chart bar scaling (min-height baseline / fixed y-scale) and label overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now 1100 lines with 14 screen components plus generateGstBill, CSV and JSON sync logic inline - split into /screens and /components before it grows further.

The sync-import-input handler writes every key from the uploaded JSON straight into localStorage with no schema/type validation (only skips keys starting with '_'); a malformed or hostile file can corrupt products/orders and force a reload loop. Validate keys against an allow-list and JSON.parse each value before persisting.
sync-export-btn / csv-export-btn create object URLs via URL.createObjectURL and never call URL.revokeObjectURL - leaks blobs on repeated exports (same for generateGstBill).
PredictorScreen still dereferences p.p (const trend = next.val > p.p) without the null guard used for 'history'; deleting the selected product in Admin while on this screen will throw.
readFile helper remains duplicated in AdminScreen and GalleryScreen - extract one util (DRY).
Gallery stores full base64 data URLs in localStorage; ~100 photos will exceed the 5MB quota and ls.set only console.errors, silently losing data.
Admin PIN '6301' is hardcoded in the client bundle and adminUnlocked resets on reload - no real access control (acceptable only as a demo gate).
OTP is generated client-side and shown via alert() with no expiry/rate limit - mock only, must not ship as auth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% client-side (localStorage, no backend). Always: (1) page.goto fresh, (2) if [data-testid=hamburger-menu] exists, close it with page.evaluate("document.querySelector('div.fixed.inset-0.z-40').click()") - clicking hamburger-btn will TIME OUT because the backdrop covers it, and the browser session persists between tool runs so a left-open menu blocks every subsequent click; (3) localStorage.clear() + reload. Attach page.on('dialog') (OTP, wrong PIN, banner/UPI save, CSV import) and page.on('popup') (order confirm auto-WA, GST WhatsApp, GST invoice blob). Note wa.me URLs resolve to https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=916301456725&text=... - assert on 'phone=916301456725', not on the wa.me literal. Downloads: use page.expect_download for csv-export-btn (as-prices.csv) and sync-export-btn (as-buildmart-sync-*.json). All 8 features and every top-level/hamburger button verified working this iteration; only re-verify the backdrop z-index fix, product imagery and gallery file-input styling.
rca_of_the_issue: Hamburger close-button obstruction: App.js line 190 renders the dismiss backdrop as <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={close} /> while the parent <header> is 'sticky top-0 z-40'. Equal z-index means DOM order decides, and the backdrop paints after the header, so it sits on top of hamburger-btn (the menu panel escapes only because it is z-50). Result: the X is unreachable for pointer events; the close still appears to work solely because the backdrop's onClick handler does the same thing. Product imagery: the CFG/product seed data reuses 6 Unsplash photo IDs across 18 SKUs.
